description: Expected results of jq filters on the named inputs. error is compile for a filter that does not compile and runtime for a run that ends with an error after the listed outputs.

cases.filter: if .a == 1 then "one" elif .a == 2 then "two" else "many" end
[.b[] | try (if . == 2 then error("two") else . end) catch "caught"]
label $out | .b[] | if . > 1 then ., break $out else . end
.b | map(try (if . > 2 then error("big") else . end) catch -1)
def fac: if . <= 1 then 1 else . * (. - 1 | fac) end; 5 | fac
